principle: The caller selects checks, cases and budgets. The service executes explicit requests and returns reusable, scoped evidence without inferring intent.

tickets.title: Linear correctness diagnostics and import failure short circuit
acceptance: Diagnostic outputs and threshold boundaries match the previous implementation
Known import failures do not materialize normal workload tensors

tickets.title: Batch profile cases and share metadata discovery
acceptance: One outer engine invocation covers an explicit case selection
Built-in workload descriptions require no tensor allocation
Only requested deep metric groups and per-core sampling execute

tickets.title: Joint timing and trace execution
acceptance: Event timing completes before trace capture
Profiler timing reuses its capture for trace output
One candidate subprocess serves the combined request
Valid timing survives later trace failure
Single-source measurements remain explicitly unverified

tickets.title: Expose fenced stage evidence through a progress endpoint
acceptance: Correctness and timing can be retrieved before the whole evaluation terminates
Progress obeys read authorization and attempt fencing
Replacement attempts cannot inherit earlier attempt progress

tickets.title: Expose explicit controls and combined requests in the portable CLI
acceptance: CLI supports combined checks, case selection, timing protocol and profile modes
Chosen options reach the service without altering unrelated request defaults
A progress command recovers stage evidence

tickets.title: Explicit correctness selection and failure stopping
acceptance: Caller can select cases and stop after a proven mismatch
Results distinguish selected, executed and not-run cases
Partial coverage never establishes whole-task correctness

tickets.title: Reuse explicitly referenced correctness evidence
acceptance: An unchanged candidate can be timed using a caller-visible completed correctness evaluation
Source, inputs, environment, algorithms and freshness are checked
Invalid or inaccessible evidence never silently authorizes a benchmark

tickets.title: CPU integration acceptance and NPU comparison harness
acceptance: Focused and full CPU checks pass
NPU script compares separate and combined execution with identical inputs and methods
Reports separate functional acceptance from measured device speedups
The user performs the final NPU measurements

review_findings_fixed: Progress revisions advance atomically when attempts are invalidated, replaced or terminalized.
Comparison timing is bound to the requested method and verified case inventory.
Explicit correctness reuse materializes frozen sources and uses the real bound handoff gate.
Reuse requires complete environment identity; absent versions do not count as a match.
Card-affinity queue scans page past ineligible entries while preserving eligible FIFO and queue priority.
Joint input replay supports nonleaf tensor views and preserves storage aliases.
NPU comparison uses complete matched pairs, preserves non_compute and reports timing drift separately.
implementation_limits: Combined execution applies to timing plus the explicit trace mode; op/deep native captures remain separate.
Correctness still has its own engine process unless explicitly reused from a valid original observation.
Fresh reference-only baseline production remains isolated from candidate execution.
CPU tests do not establish actual NPU speedups; the user runs the final measurement.
